Messages.Author: mostly harmless
Messages.Body:
Ok, this may sound a bit strange, but:

Can I still use Carlotta's special ability if I don't have any more
cards in my hand? I.e. can I 'exchange' a card for nothing?

Michael

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. The card in your hand mentioned on card text must exist.
cf. Fast Reaction when there is no blocking minion.
